title.en: A picture is a grid of numbers

narration.en: A grey image is one grid. A colour image is three, and each cell is a brightness, not an object.
narration.ar-EG: الصورة الرمادية شبكة واحدة. والملونة تلاتة، وكل خانة سطوع، مش حاجة.

narration.en: A three by three filter lays on the picture and multiplies nine cells. It writes that sum as the new pixel.
